name: Takahara Chiaki
source:
Chiaki originally enrolled in Kimisaki High because of her interest in lacrosse. She usually practices hard, but gets swayed by [url=/c98320]Runa[/url] and [url=/c98387]Qoo[/url] from time to time to slack off. Chiaki and [url=/c98229]Chiyo[/url] are good friends. Chiaki is the kind of person that will reach out to anyone in need of help.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
